title: Nog 'n meme? AI video shows Rassie Erasmus serenading Webb Ellis Cup to Vanessa Carlton classic
source_used: Daily Voice (South Africa), 4 Oct 2026; the IOL page itself is blocked by a Cloudflare security page
key_facts: An AI-generated video shows Springboks head coach Rassie Erasmus in place of Terry Crews in the car-singing scene from the film White Chicks.
In the clip he sings Vanessa Carlton's "A Thousand Miles" to the Webb Ellis Cup, the Rugby World Cup trophy.
Daily Voice calls the clip undeniably artificial and says it could still become a big hit.
The clip appeared after the Springboks' 42-38 defeat to Australia in Perth, in which Erasmus made 13 squad changes.
Before that the Springboks had won a Test series 3-1 against the All Blacks.
Erasmus is known for playful social media videos, for example dancing to local hits.
quote_evidence: The video parodies the iconic scene from the movie "White Chicks", where Terry Crews enthusiastically sings along to Vanessa Carlton’s “A Thousand Miles” in a convertible.
Even though the clip is undeniably artificial, a vergatlike musical performance isn’t entirely beyond the realm of possibility for Erasmus.
The viral clip arrives as the Springboks look to regroup following a high-scoring 42-38 defeat to Australia in Perth over the weekend.
why_it_matters_hint: A harmless AI parody of a sports figure, and a sign of how easily AI video now puts public figures into film scenes.
